name: Trishakti Industries Ltd
about: Trishakti Industries Ltd. is a leading infrastructure company with a focus on providing heavy earth-moving equipment solutions to major industrial and infrastructure players.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3][4]
a) TIL is an infrastructure solutions provider, specializing in hiring heavy earth-moving equipment.
b) It has a diverse fleet of advanced machinery through which it supports large-scale projects across sectors
c) Company was involved in supplying drilling equipment to ONGC for oil and gas exploration, participating in global tenders and offering related services but has since shifted its focus towards infrastructure sector by introducing crane hiring services
d) It is also a marketing company representing Oil & Gas equipment manufacturers worldwide for selling products to Indian companies like ONGC /OIL, etc.
e) Currently, it has 100+ Clients, serving 20+ Industries, and 20+ Ongoing Projects
f) It has also started dealing in stocks and shares

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 29.8%
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 51.8 days to 14.1 days
cons: Stock is trading at 6.49 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 11.7% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 253 days.
